# Konto — AI-readable information

Konto is a finance application that helps freelancers and small-business owners understand their personal and professional financial situation. It combines account balances, transactions, investments, crypto, budgets, cash flow, patrimoine, tax estimates, credit capacity, property ROI, and reports.

Bank connections use Powens open banking. Konto does not receive bank passwords and is designed for read-only financial data access; sensitive connection data is encrypted. The application also supports sandbox/demo mode without connecting a bank.
